Sonam Wangchuk Ends Hunger Strike After 26 Days

Sonam Wangchuk, an Indian environmental activist, ended a 26-day hunger strike after negotiating with the government. The negotiations were facilitated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi's late-night message. Wangchuk had been protesting against the government's handling of climate change and environmental issues. He was supported by various youth-led protests across India. The talks between the government and movement leaders stalled, but Wangchuk secured a 'hard bargain'.
